name: Tomasz Bednarek
description: Aktor teatralny, filmowy i jeden z najbardziej rozpoznawalnych głosów polskiego dubbingu. descriptionEn: Theatre, film and voice actor, one of the most recognisable voices in Polish dubbing. Graduate of the Wrocław Theatre Academy (PWST, 1992), known to wide audiences for his role as Jacek Borecki in the TV series 'Klan'. He has voiced hundreds of characters in films, series and animations, most notably Donkey in the 'Shrek' franchise, as well as roles in 'Tabaluga', 'Elmo's World', 'Star Wars' and 'Madagascar'. He combines decades of stage and radio experience with outstanding microphone technique, a distinctive voice timbre, interpretive precision and a wide emotional range.
